package.name: emori_adapter_ros
package.description: EMORI -> ROS4HRI adapter node: publishes REP-155 engagement and context topics from a session source (mock, or the live robot hub relay, which also carries replayed sessions). Runs the emori_adapter core (Translator) and publishes /humans/persons/tracked, /humans/persons/<id>/engagement_status, and the structured emori_msgs/Context.
